decisions.reason: New Rapid7 analysis of the same SonicWall SMA1000 zero-days already tracked in this story. Adds vendor disclosure detail but is the same incident.

CVE-2026-83548.evidence: SonicWall confirmed active exploitation of both CVEs. CVE-2026-83548 (SSRF, CVSS 10.0) chains with CVE-2026-83549 (command injection) for unauthenticated RCE.

CVE-2026-83549.evidence: SonicWall confirmed active exploitation. Alone requires auth, but chained with CVE-2026-83548 enables unauthenticated OS command execution.
